[[Zho]] is available as a [[henchman]] in [[Factions]] and in all [[Eye of the North]] outposts. Zho's eye was pecked out by the [[Black Moa]] in the [[Echovald Forest]], when she was trying to save [[Nehdukah]]. In [[The Norn Fighting Tournament]], she has a [[pet]] named [[Onyx]]; a Black Moa whose origin is detailed in [[Zho's Journal]], despite Zho's unfortunate history with the species.

She is labeled as an "[[Archer Henchman]]" in [[Guild Wars Factions]], and an "[[Interrupt Henchman]]" in [[Guild Wars Eye of the North]].

==Evaluation==

====Factions====
;Pros
*Good [[damage]] output.
*Has an [[interrupt]]ion skill.
*[[Melandru's Shot]] provides decent damage.
*Can inflict [[Bleeding]] and [[Crippled]].
;Cons
*Has no defensive [[stance]]s.
*No [[energy management]].
*Outside the Raisu Palace and Imperial Sanctum missions, she only has 7 skills equipped.

====Eye of the North====
;Pros
*Many interrupting skills.
*Dazed condition inflicting skill.
*Has one defensive stance.
*Can [[cover]] Dazed with Bleeding from [[Hunter's Shot]].
;Cons
*Low damage output.
*Has no energy management.
*Similar to other Ranger [[NPC]]s, she will activate Read the Wind whenever the [[duration]] of the [[preparation]] has ended, even when the [[party]] is being attacked, missing the opportunity to interrupt foes.

==Dialogue==

====Factions====
Kinya Province (to [[Factions]] [[ranger]] characters):
:''"Call me Zho. I will be your trainer. I would much rather train than talk, so let us get to work.''

:''What would you like to study first?"''

Kinya Province (to Factions non-ranger characters)
:''"What is it? I only have one eye, and I use it to keep track of my own students. Move along and find your headmaster."''

Kinya Province (to non-Factions characters)
:''"I am afraid I cannot help you. You are not a student here. And do not bother trying to become one...that honor is reserved for Canthans."''

Monastery Overlook (during [[Snaring Course]]):
:''"Now is not the time to talk. Please concentrate on your studies."''

Jaya Bluffs:
:''"This is not the time."''

Zen Daijun (outpost):
:''"Master Togo seems very worried by this plague and that worries me. There isn't much that man hasn't seen. What did you need?"''

Kaineng City town and outposts:
:''"We have come here to accomplish a task. All actions that go toward completing that goal are acceptable. All else is wasteful.''

:''What do you need?"''

The Jade Sea town and outposts:
:''"I may lack an eye, but my aim is true and my bow is stout. I know forests and plains like the back of my hand. Just let me know if there's anything I can do to help repair the damage the plague has done here.''

:''What did you need?"''

Divine Path:
:''"I will forever remember fighting by your side, <character name>."''

====Eye of the North====
Far Shiverpeaks towns and outposts:
:''"Hail. Are you the traveler they speak of? I'm your guide. I was taught the ways of the wilderness since I was a child. You'll find no better."''

Gunnar's Hold after defeating her in [[the Norn Fighting Tournament]] and not having a copy of [[Zho's Journal]] in [[inventory]]:
:''"Some traveller {{sic}} found my journal on the ground and returned it to me. Did it fall out of your pack? Don't worry! It's safe. Just a little dirty. Would you like it back?"
:;{{ask|gold}} Goodness! I hadn't even noticed it missing. Yes I would like it back! Thank you.
::''"You're welcome. And don't worry, I'm quite well known amongst the travelers. Should you misplace it again, come find me. I'm sure it will make its way back here."

Charr Homelands towns and outposts:
:''"Burned, charred, scorched. Such destruction wounds the land. She is but a shadow of her former beauty."''

Tarnished Coast towns and outposts:
:''"Listen to the forest and smell the battle on the wind. This place is more alive than you realize."''

Central Transfer Chamber:
:''"Do not think of caverns as a grave. Think of them as earth, and you are the seed. Soon enough, we will see the fruit of our labors."''

Epilogue:
:''"May the arrow of your life always fly true, and may you find your target at the end of flight."''

==Quotes==

====Factions====
Shing Jea Island:
:''"I was tracking the legendary [[Black Moa|black moa]] one cold day in the [[Echovald Forest]]. For weeks I had gone without catching even a glimpse of it when suddenly I heard its unmistakable call. Let me tell you there's no more chilling sound you can ever hear, it froze the very marrow in my bones. I crept along as silently as possible but too late I was, the evil beast has seen me and attacked. It was a horrible struggle; I barely escaped with my life and lost an eye in the process. Pray that you never see a black moa, and if you do, run for your life."''
:''"It's easy to track these plague creatures, all you have to do is follow the trail of pus."''
:''"[[Tiger]]s and [[crane]]s are good pets. However, there are even more exotic [[animal]]s to be found in the Echovald Forest, have you ever heard of the legendary black moa?"''

:''"It is difficult to find tracks in a place such as this."''
:''"The eyes of our enemies watch us everywhere."''

:''"These tracks are fresh. Be wary."''

:''"Hey, who hasn't heard the tale of the legendary [[Black Moa|black moa]]?"''

:''"[[Sheldon the Verminator]]... he was a worthy foe. You can't tame a wild beast like that."''
:''"Yes, I only have one eye. No, I'm not a [[corsair]]. Any more questions?"''

== Notes ==
* If your character needs another copy of [[Zho's Journal]], you can get one from her in [[Gunnar's Hold]]. (Your character must have already obtained an original via [[the Norn Fighting Tournament]].)
* She wields a [[Longbow]].

==Trivia==
* Her henchmen skill sets were changed in the [[Game updates/20091022|October 22, 2009 update]]. As an ally in Unwaking Waters and a henchman in Raisu Palace and Imperial Sanctum, she uses the skill set prior to that update.
** Factions: This added [[Determined Shot]], and removed [[Power Shot]] from her skills. 
** Eye of the North: This added [[Attacker's Insight]] and [[Determined Shot]], and removed [[Penetrating Attack]] from her skills. 
* Her Eye of the North henchman skill set was changed in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20110217|February 17, 2011 update]]
** This added [[Natural Healing]] and [[Whirling Defense]], and removed [[Attacker's Insight]] and [[Troll Unguent]] from her skills.
